scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); for (const file of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']) { try { fs.unlinkSync(path.join(process.cwd(), file)); } catch (error) { if (error && error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; } } const userAgent = process.env.npm_config_user_agent || ''; if (!userAgent.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
